summary_zh:
前往這瀑布有兩條路線 - 862(西側) 與 864 (東側)，我會比較推薦 864 東側比較好，能步行到瀑布旁邊 (約20-30分)，景觀較好，電影「異形 - 普羅米修斯」場景，就在這瀑布的西側這頭取景。

但是 864 這裡常封路，能到的機會有限，一般人比較常從 862 (西側) 過來，地勢較高，但景觀相對不如 864 東側來的壯觀，但862東側，地勢比較高，從停車場步行過來距離也比較短一點，也需約 20 分鐘，所以前來這裡需要預留多一點時間。
summary_en: There are two routes to reach the waterfall: Route 862 (west side) and Route 864 (east side). Route 864 is recommended because it allows a short walk (about 20-30 minutes) right to the waterfall and offers better scenery; the movie “Prometheus” was filmed on the west side of the waterfall. However, Route 864 is often closed, so access can be limited. Most visitors use Route 862 (west side), which is higher in elevation but the view is not as spectacular as Route 864. From the parking lot on Route 862, the walk to the waterfall is slightly shorter, about 20 minutes, so allow extra time for the visit.
